2016

Author: Rongon Mukhopadhyay

In The High Court Of Jharkhand At Ranchi
 Cr. M.P. No. 05 of 2011
 ------

entities.text: High Court Of Jharkhand At Ranchi
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
1. Janardhan Mandal, S/o late Suresh Mandal
 2. Murlidhar Mandal, S/o late Suresh Mandal
 Both are resident of Ghormara, P.O.-Ghormara Bazar,
 P.S.- Mohanpur, District- Deoghar ... ... Petitioners

Coram : Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Rongon Mukhopadhyay
 ------

For the Petitioners : Mrs. Vandana Singh, Advocate
 Mr. Sudhansu Kumar Deo, Advocate

For the State : Mr. Amresh Kumar, A.P.P.
 ------
04/13.06.2016 Heard Mrs. Vandana Singh, learned counsel appearing for the petitioners and Mr. Amresh Kumar,
learned A.P.P. for the State.

Mrs. Vandana Singh, learned counsel appearing for the petitioners submits that the report of public analyst of the State was never served upon the petitioners and only on receiving notice by the Civil Surgeon, an application was made by the petitioners on 28.05.2008, for sending the sample to the Central Food Laboratory, Kolkata.

Learned counsel for the petitioners further submits that non submission of the report of the public analyst means violation of Section 13(2) of the Prevention of Food Adulteration Act, 1954, as the valuable right of the petitioners have been curbed.

Mr. Amresh Kumar, learned A.P.P. for the State is directed to take instructions and file a counter affidavit and also specifically state as to whether the report of the public analyst was served upon the petitioners or not and if served, shall also mention the date on which the public analyst report was served.
List this case on 12th July, 2016.

Until further orders, proceeding in connection with G.O.C.R. Case No. 52 of 2008 having T.R. No.
1531 of 2008, pending in the court of learned S.D.J.M. at Deoghar, shall remain stayed.
